Definition: Nemuel, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Nemuel is the name of two Israelites: the son of Eliab of Reuben, and the son of Simeon whose sons are the Nemuelites. Both stand in the numberings of their tribes, one in Reuben's line and one in Simeon's.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the double name is kept on purpose: two men, two tribes, one name, and God counts them both without confusing them.
